market_question: Will Arsenal finish in 2nd place in the 2025-26 English Premier League?
reasoning: Arsenal have finished 2nd in the last two seasons, but predicting the exact ordinal finish two years out carries huge uncertainty. Manchester City, Liverpool, and improving Chelsea/United sides all alter the top-4 distribution. The base rate for any top team to land exactly 2nd in a given future season is well under 16.5%, making the market price too high.
evidence_points: Arsenal’s recent 2nd-place finishes were in 2022–23 and 2023–24, but 2025–26 is a different season with unknown player movements.
Only one team can finish 2nd; multiple clubs (City, Liverpool, Chelsea, etc.) are credible contenders for a top-2 spot.
Probabilities for exact position are typically capped below 15% for all but the very strongest teams, even one season ahead.
